Eligible Tenderers will be qualified only if their available tender capacity is more than total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under: Assessed available tender capacity is equal to ( A x N x 2.5 - B ) where,A is equal to Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years at 2025-26 price level (updated to the Financial year in which the tender is invited) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress.N is equal to Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which Tenders are invited.B is equal to Value, at 2025-26 price level (updated to the Financial year in which the tender is invited) of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 6 months/0.5years (period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited).Note:The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent.

To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in his name should have in the last five years period. i.e., 2021-22 ,2022-23, 2023-24,2024-25 & 2025-26 Achieved in at least TWO financial years an average annual financial turnover (in all Class of Civil Engineering Construction Works only) of Rs. 15.25 Lakhs. (Usually not less than the estimated annual payment under this contract) (Updated to the FY in which the tenders are invited. Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited).

itemList.description:
Design and Construction of an Artistic Ticket Counter
1. Design and construction of an Artistic ticket counter at the entrance of the Rock Garden, covering a built-up area of 11 ft. x 14 ft. The structure shall utilize Sadarahalli Grey granite/red stone or other stones pre-approved by the competent authority. The stone fabrication process includes cutting, curving, and carving ornamental designs into the stone. The final artistic design of the ticket counter structure must be approved by the competent authority prior to execution. 
2. Substructure, Columns, and Framework: The foundational substructure shall feature a stone base with a total length of 50 Rft. and a cross-sectional area of 1 ft. x 8 inch. The surrounding veneer wall must maintain a minimum thickness of 8 inch. This entire wall assembly shall be supported by 8 stone columns, each measuring 1.5 ft. x 1.5 ft. with a minimum height of 10 ft. These columns will carry a stone beam with a total length of 50 Rft. and a cross-sectional size of 1 ft. x 1 ft. The beam framework will be further detailed with 8 stone capitals measuring 2 ft. x 2 ft. x 1 ft. The scope includes providing all necessary foundation works for the entire structure in accordance with the approved design.
3. Roof, Flooring, and Fixtures: The superstructure shall be topped with a 5inch thick stone roof slab covering an overall area of 11 ft. x 14 ft. The interior flooring shall consist of durable stone slabs with a minimum thickness of 50 mm. The front of the counter is to be equipped with toughened glass featuring two ticket window openings, which must be protected by Mild Steel (MS) or Cast Iron (CI) grills. All door and window openings must be fitted with robust stone frames. The windows shall feature glass shutters, and the doors are to be equipped with premium teak wood shutters.
 4. Material Supply and Execution: The overall scope of work includes dismantling of existing hut structure and the supply of all necessary materials including cement, sand, aggregates, and specialized stone binding agents along with all required lead and lift. The project must be executed on a complete turnkey basis and completed in its entirety as directed by the Engineer in Charge.
